rows.grounds: compound yoni + yantra in locative plural
past participle of pīḍ in nominative plural

items.question: Are beings tormented within the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: Beings are described as tormented in them.
items.inference: Thus embodiment across many wombs involves torment.
uncertainties: The exact referent of yoniyantreṣu remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
